name: Fireside
reviews: One of my new go-to restaurants. Excellent presentation, variety and quality of food, and service from staff. Generous portion sizes too, so good value for money. Will definitely be returning with friends/family.

It‘s my first time to eat it. It tastes good. The fried rice noodles are great. I like it very much.

Stir-fried beef is also very delicious.  I will come again.
Amazing lunch deal! The food was delicious, the portions were really generous, and the price was excellent. One of the best value lunches I’ve had. Highly recommend!
Came back for a lot of times already.
